docs.t: Abraham Accords
docs.h: ACCORDS-001 international agreement and prophetic interpretation documented-event-with-cited-record
docs.b: Agreements documented; prophetic connection is interpretation The 2020 Abraham Accords documents record normalization agreements and declarations involving Israel and the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain, followed by additional normalization arrangements. That the agreements establish the author's prophetic timeline or imply a particular future outcome.

docs.t: AI as a system of control
docs.h: AI-001 technology forecast and theological interpretation author-hypothesis-or-prophetic-interpretation
docs.b: Prophetic analogy, not a demonstrated coordinated system AI systems can be used for classification, surveillance, content moderation, and automated decisions; individual deployments require specific evidence. That AI is already coordinated as a single mechanism to identify and punish dissent or that neural interfaces are intended to deliver control.

docs.t: CBDC pilots and programmable-money claims
docs.h: CBDC-001 technology status and forecast author-hypothesis-or-prophetic-interpretation
docs.b: Proposed or piloted systems are not universal deployment Central banks and international bodies have studied or piloted CBDCs; design choices are jurisdiction-specific. That all CBDCs are programmable, that pilots generally include expiry dates or spending limits, or that a unified global system is being implemented.

docs.t: Charlottesville statements and 'very fine people'
docs.h: CHAR-001 documented public statements disputed-interpretation
docs.b: Multiple statements over several days require full context Trump condemned hatred, bigotry, and violence; on August 15 he also said there were 'very fine people on both sides' and then said he was not referring to neo-Nazis and white nationalists, who should be condemned totally. The archive's assertion that media reports uniformly cut the second half of a sentence.

docs.t: Lockdowns, mandates, and pandemic policy
docs.h: COVID-001 policy outcomes and spiritual interpretation author-hypothesis-or-prophetic-interpretation
docs.b: Effects varied; spiritual framing is interpretation Public-health restrictions varied by jurisdiction, time, and design; economic and health effects require specific outcome measures. That lockdowns were designed as submission training, or that restrictions as a whole destroyed small businesses.

docs.t: April 2020 disinfectant and light remarks
docs.h: DISINFECTANT-001 documented public statement documented-event-with-cited-record
docs.b: No verbatim 'inject bleach' instruction; transcript contains injection speculation The April 23, 2020 briefing transcript records Trump publicly asking whether disinfectant could be used by injection inside the body and discussing light/heat after a researcher presentation. The claim that the remarks referred only to light-based therapies or that media invented the injection discussion.

docs.t: Claims that swing-state election rules changed illegally
docs.h: ELECTION-001 election-law allegation unverified-claim-requiring-additional-evidence
docs.b: Jurisdiction-specific legal claim required Election procedures and deadlines differed by state and were litigated before and after the 2020 election. Which state rule was unlawful, what official changed it, and whether a court issued a final finding of illegality affecting an election result.

docs.t: Foreign payments to Biden family members and associates
docs.h: FIN-BIDEN-001 financial relationship allegation documented-allegation-or-testimony
docs.b: Payments and alleged wrongdoing must be distinguished Bank records and committee documents may establish that funds moved among named companies, associates, and relatives. Whether any payment was unlawful, what services it represented, whether Joe Biden received a payment, or whether he took an official action in exchange.

docs.t: Foreign-government donations to the Clinton Foundation
docs.h: FIN-CLINTON-001 financial relationship allegation unverified-claim-requiring-additional-evidence
docs.b: Specific amounts and influence not established here A foundation's audited filings and donor records can establish reported contributions and dates. The broad amount, the identity and timing of each alleged foreign-government donor, and any exchange or policy influence.

docs.t: Nancy Pelosi stock trades and legislative timing
docs.h: FIN-PELOSI-001 financial relationship allegation unverified-claim-requiring-additional-evidence
docs.b: Trade timing and influence not established Congressional disclosure filings can establish reported transactions, dates, and ownership interests. That a trade preceded a particular legislative action, generated the claimed gain, or violated insider-trading law.

docs.t: Crossfire Hurricane and Carter Page FISA applications
docs.h: FISA-001 official oversight findings and interpretation documented-event-with-cited-record
docs.b: Serious application errors documented; shorthand overstates Official oversight found serious inaccuracies and omissions in applications to surveil Carter Page and criticized FBI handling of the matter. That every application was based on a 'fake dossier,' that the FBI knew the dossier was false at the time, or that the full investigation was simply a plot to spy on Trump.

docs.t: First Step Act releases and demographic effects
docs.h: FSA-001 enacted law and administrative outcome documented-event-with-cited-record
docs.b: Law enacted; totals and demographics need dated data The First Step Act was enacted in 2018 and created sentencing, earned-time-credit, and reentry provisions. The quoted number of people released, the date range, which provisions produced releases, and whether the affected group was 'mostly Black men.'

docs.t: Digital identity and a global control ledger
docs.h: ID-001 technology claim and prophetic interpretation author-hypothesis-or-prophetic-interpretation
docs.b: Separate projects do not establish a unified compulsory ledger Digital identity programs and biometric systems are proposed or deployed in particular countries and services. That a global system merges identity, health, wallet, and location data or that access to ordinary life is universally conditioned on one ID.

docs.t: The $35 Medicare insulin cap
docs.h: INS-001 federal policy and attribution documented-event-with-cited-record
docs.b: Attribution differs by program and date A $35 insulin limit was used in a voluntary CMS model for participating plans; a later statute established a broader Medicare cap. The original gives no date or distinction between the voluntary model and the later statutory benefit.

docs.t: Pre-pandemic unemployment rates
docs.h: LABOR-001 economic statistic documented-event-with-cited-record
docs.b: A historical low needs population and date qualifiers BLS time series can establish unemployment rates by race, ethnicity, sex, and month. The statement's undefined meaning of 'record-low' across four populations and the exact comparison period.

docs.t: The October 2020 letter by 51 former intelligence officials
docs.h: LAPTOP-001 public statement and characterization documented-allegation-or-testimony
docs.b: The letter's wording is narrower than the archive says The signatories said the laptop reporting had 'all the classic earmarks of a Russian information operation' and expressly said they did not know whether the emails were genuine. That the signatories falsely stated the laptop was Russian disinformation; the letter described an inference and caveat, not an authentication finding.

docs.t: Government contacts with social-media companies
docs.h: MOD-001 documented contacts and contested characterization disputed-interpretation
docs.b: Some contacts documented; broad censorship conclusion not established Public records and platform communications show some government-platform contacts about content moderation and public-health or election misinformation. That agencies coordinated a general program to silence political dissent, blacklisted all named doctors, or directed every platform decision described in the archive.

docs.t: NIH/NIAID grants and gain-of-function allegations
docs.h: NIH-001 grant record and disputed scientific classification disputed-interpretation
docs.b: Funding and research classification must be stated separately A U.S.-funded grant supported EcoHealth Alliance research that included work with the Wuhan Institute of Virology; the scope and reporting of experiments have been the subject of official review. That Fauci personally funded a specific experiment or that the grant funded the creation of SARS-CoV-2.

docs.t: Qatar aircraft offer, acceptance, and use
docs.h: QAT-001 historical event and legal/ethics interpretation documented-event-with-cited-record
docs.b: Pentagon acceptance reported May 21, 2025; operations and disposition remain open The two supplied contemporaneous reports say Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell confirmed on May 21, 2025, that the Defense Department accepted a Boeing 747 from Qatar for Air Force One use. This supports federal acceptance as a documented event; their page contents were not independently inspected in this session. Whether and when the aircraft was modified, certified, or operated; whether Donald Trump personally flew on it; the final ownership and disposition; and the full legal, security, cost, and ethics analysis.

docs.t: U.S. citizens killed in overseas drone strikes
docs.h: SURV-OBAMA-001 documented event and legal dispute disputed-interpretation
docs.b: Specific operation and legal record required The claim concerns targeted lethal operations against U.S. citizens abroad and the government's legal rationale. The plural wording, complete list of affected citizens, operation details, and the legal characterization implied by 'without trial.'

docs.t: COVID-19 vaccines and transmission
docs.h: VAX-001 public-health evidence unverified-claim-requiring-additional-evidence
docs.b: Effect depends on period, variant, and outcome Vaccine effectiveness against infection and onward transmission varied with variant, time since vaccination, and population; estimates require a dated study and outcome. The absolute claim that vaccination did or did not prevent spread in all settings.
